t: Praise that fills the heavens and the earth
a: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا لَكَ الْحَمْدُ مِلْءَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَمِلْءَ الأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَىْءٍ بَعْدُ
p: Allāhumma rabbanā laka-l-ḥamd, mil'a-s-samāwāti wa mil'a-l-arḍ, wa mil'a mā shi'ta min shay'in baʿd.
m: O Allah, our Lord, and to You is praise, filling the heavens and filling the earth, and filling whatever else You will.
